resources.string: Jarvis aap ki awaaz ke hukm par screen parhta hai aur tap, type, scroll karta hai taake kisi bhi app ko chala sake. Volume-down 3 dafa dabane se Jarvis foran ruk jaata hai. Paise, delete ya security wale kaam hamesha aap ki fingerprint tasdeeq ke baad hote hain. Jarvis password, PIN, OTP ya card number kabhi type nahi karta.
